title: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-70-0009 R1 RTD+Transmitter
summary:
- Material must meet all dimensional, quality, marking, and stamping requirements.
- Vendor data is crucial for project progress.
- Quotations must include time for approval drawings and fabricate after drawing approval.
- Equipment must pass inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
- Confidentiality of information and know-how is required.
- Alternate quotations are welcome to improve price, delivery, or performance.
- The document describes the engineering specifications for a RTD + Transmitter Cooling System used in TES Pump Bearing Cooling Systems.
- It includes details on temperature sensors, thermowells, and temperature transmitters.
- Environmental conditions and warranty terms are also specified.
- The document is part of a larger project for the Solana power plant.
